test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The pie charts given below show the workers doing different types of works in an office in 2005 and 2006.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d1ba6c2526b0aaf5584b34d1b8bc4d104e2ba6770f1568ce28b88328aa054e9.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9a463c74b0654210918740eaa68f4289a2c8abb21612d74050da4037b06bcf4.png] 

The total number of workers of which two types of work in 2005 was equal to the number of workers doing U-type of work in 2006?
solution:
**Calculation**

The number of workers doing U-type of work in 2006 = 22%

⇒ 22% of 54000 = 11880

The total number of workers doing W-type of work in 2005 = 10% of 47520

= 4752

The total number of workers doing X-type of work in 2005 = 15% of 47520

= 7128

Total workers in W and X type of work in 2005 = 4752 + 7128 = 11880

22% of 54000 = 10% of 47520(W) + 15% of 47520(X)

**The answer is W and X**
